surfaces.name: the site header and primary nav
the desk command bar and brand

aspects.name: TYPE SCALE
moves: List every font size used on {s} and map each to the type scale.
Raise any text on {s} that renders below the legibility floor.
Give {s} one line-height per size step instead of per element.
Replace letter-spacing hacks on {s} with the size step that fits.
Keep numerals on {s} tabular so digits never shift.
Check {s} at 200% browser zoom for clipped or overlapping text.
bars: every size is a scale token

aspects.name: CONTRAST
moves: Measure every text and background pair on {s}.
Raise any pair on {s} below the bar with a solid token colour, not opacity.
Check {s} over each skin: GENESIS, REGALIA, AURUM and OFF.
Check focus rings and borders on {s} against their backgrounds.
Replace dimmed-by-opacity text on {s} with a named muted token.
Check {s} in forced-colors (high contrast) mode.
bars: 4.5:1 body, 3:1 large text and UI edges

aspects.name: SPACING RHYTHM
moves: Record every margin and padding on {s} and map each to the 4px grid.
Snap off-grid spacing on {s} to the nearest step.
Make vertical rhythm on {s} consistent between siblings.
Give {s} equal optical padding on all sides of its frame.
Remove double spacing where borders and margins stack on {s}.
Tokenise the spacing on {s} so a single change updates it everywhere.

aspects.name: ALIGNMENT & GRID
moves: Overlay the grid on {s} and note every element off it.
Align the baselines of labels and values on {s}.
Centre icons on {s} optically, not just by bounding box.
Make edges of adjacent blocks on {s} share one line.
Check {s} for half-pixel blur at DPR 2 and 3.
Lock the column structure of {s} so content cannot shift it.

aspects.name: HIERARCHY
moves: Name the single most important thing on {s} and check it reads first.
Reduce competing emphasis on {s}: one hero per view.
Order {s} so reading order matches visual order.
Give headings on {s} a consistent level structure.
Demote decorative labels on {s} below data labels.
Test {s} with a five-second glance: what is remembered?
bars: glance test passes for a new visitor

aspects.name: TOUCH TARGETS
moves: Measure every control on {s} and list any under the bar.
Grow undersized targets on {s} with padding, not visual size.
Separate adjacent targets on {s} so a thumb cannot hit two.
Keep {s} controls clear of the home indicator and screen edges.
Give {s} a pressed state that shows within one frame.
Check {s} one-handed on a 390px screen.

aspects.name: FOCUS & KEYBOARD
moves: Tab through {s} and record the order and every trap.
Give every control on {s} a visible focus ring.
Make {s} fully usable with keyboard alone.
Return focus to the trigger when {s} closes or changes view.
Add arrow-key movement where {s} is a group.
Check {s} with a switch-access tab order.

aspects.name: SCREEN-READER NAMING
moves: Read {s} with VoiceOver and note every unnamed or misnamed element.
Give each control on {s} an accessible name that matches its label.
Hide decoration on {s} from assistive technology.
Announce changes on {s} politely, and no more than needed.
Give values on {s} their units in the accessible name.
Add landmarks and headings so {s} can be navigated by rotor.

aspects.name: MOTION DISCIPLINE
moves: List every animation and transition on {s} with its duration.
Remove any constant or looping motion from {s}.
Honour reduced motion on {s} with an instant equivalent.
Keep {s} motion under 250ms and tied to a user action.
Animate {s} with transform and opacity only.
Check {s} for layout shift during motion.

aspects.name: WEIGHT & SPEED
moves: Measure the bytes {s} costs on first load.
Cut the largest single cost of {s}.
Serve {s} in a smaller format where one exists.
Load {s} only when it is needed.
Check {s} on a slow 3G profile.
Set a byte budget for {s} and record it.

aspects.name: OFFLINE
moves: Open {s} offline after one visit and record what fails.
Precache what {s} needs to render offline.
Make {s} say clearly what is unavailable offline.
Check {s} after a service-worker update while offline.
Keep {s} usable when the network flaps.
Test {s} offline in a fresh profile.

aspects.name: EMPTY STATE
moves: Show {s} with no data yet and record what appears.
Replace blank or zero-filled output on {s} with an honest empty state.
Tell the user on {s} what will fill it and when.
Keep {s} the same size empty as full, so nothing jumps.
Distinguish 'none yet' from 'zero' on {s}.
Test {s} on a brand-new desk with no history.
bars: no zeros stand in for missing data

aspects.name: ERROR & FAILURE
moves: Break each input of {s} and record what happens.
Make {s} fail visibly, never silently.
Keep {s} usable when one source fails.
Log failures of {s} where the operator can find them.
Recover {s} automatically when the fault clears.
Test {s} against malformed and out-of-range values.

aspects.name: STALENESS
moves: Record how {s} looks when its data stops updating.
Show the age of the data on {s}.
Dim or mark {s} once its data passes the stale threshold.
Stop {s} extrapolating from stale data.
Scale the stale threshold of {s} to its update rate.
Test {s} with a feed paused for one, five and sixty minutes.
bars: stale is marked within one interval

aspects.name: NUMERIC PRECISION
moves: List every number on {s} with its decimals and units.
Give prices on {s} decimals that suit the asset's magnitude.
Use significant figures, not fixed decimals, for tiny values on {s}.
Never let {s} round a real value to zero.
Keep money, percentages and ratios on {s} in distinct formats.
bars: no non-zero value shows as zero

aspects.name: PROVENANCE
moves: Classify every value on {s}: observed, derived, inferred or model.
Label model and inferred values on {s} as such.
Show the source of observed values on {s}.
Keep inferred values on {s} visually distinct from observed ones.
Remove any value on {s} that has no real source.
Link {s} to the Data page's definitions.

aspects.name: COPY CLARITY
moves: Read {s} aloud and mark every sentence that stumbles.
Cut {s} copy to the shortest version that keeps the meaning.
Replace jargon on {s} with a glossary link or plain words.
Make labels on {s} say what a control does, not what it is.
Check claims on {s} are literally true.
Keep capitalisation and terms on {s} consistent with the glossary.

aspects.name: GENESIS FIDELITY
moves: Compare {s} under GENESIS with the skin's principles.
Remove any glow, gradient noise or motion GENESIS does not allow from {s}.
Make ornament on {s} derive from QuadCOM geometry.
Keep ornament on {s} away from data ink.
Check {s} under GENESIS at DPR 1, 2 and 3.
Check {s} degrades cleanly to OFF.

aspects.name: DARK-ROOM LEGIBILITY
moves: View {s} at minimum screen brightness and note what disappears.
Raise the faintest essential ink on {s}.
Remove large bright areas from {s} that dazzle in the dark.
Check {s} with night shift / true tone on.
Keep status colours on {s} distinguishable when dim.
Check {s} on an OLED screen for black crush.

aspects.name: SMALL SCREENS
moves: Render {s} at 320px wide and record every break.
Stop anything on {s} forcing horizontal scroll.
Reflow {s} instead of shrinking it.
Check {s} with the largest accessibility text size.
Keep primary actions of {s} visible without scrolling.
Check {s} in split-screen and slide-over widths.

aspects.name: LANDSCAPE & LARGE
moves: Render {s} in landscape and at 1920px and record wasted space.
Cap line length on {s} for comfortable reading.
Use the extra width on {s} for context, not stretch.
Check {s} on an iPad in both orientations.
Keep {s} centred and balanced on ultrawide screens.
Check {s} with the browser at 50% and 200% zoom.

aspects.name: PRINT & EXPORT
moves: Print {s} and note what is lost or wasted.
Remove navigation and ornament from {s} in print.
Keep {s} text black-on-white in print.
Show link targets on {s} in print.
Avoid page breaks inside blocks on {s}.
Export {s} to PDF and check it reads well.

aspects.name: COLOUR-BLIND SAFETY
moves: View {s} through protanopia, deuteranopia and tritanopia filters.
Pair every colour meaning on {s} with a shape, sign or word.
Check up/down on {s} are distinguishable without red and green.
Keep chart series on {s} separable in greyscale.
Check {s} status dots have a text equivalent.
Test {s} with a colour-blind reviewer.

aspects.name: LOCALE READINESS
moves: List every hard-coded format on {s}: currency, decimals, dates.
Format numbers on {s} through one locale-aware function.
Keep {s} layout intact with longer translated labels.
Use unambiguous dates and times on {s}.
Mark the language of every text part on {s}.
Check {s} with a comma decimal separator.

aspects.name: DETERMINISM
moves: Rebuild {s} twice and diff the outputs.
Remove timestamps and randomness from {s} output.
Pin every input {s} depends on.
Make {s} fail loudly on unexpected input.
Record the exact command that produces {s}.
Check {s} rebuilds the same on another machine.

aspects.name: TEST COVERAGE
moves: List what {s} does and which QA script checks each part.
Add a QA check for the riskiest untested part of {s}.
Make the QA checks for {s} fail with a clear message.
Run the QA for {s} at 390px and 1280px.
Add a regression test for the last bug found in {s}.
Time the QA for {s} and keep it fast.
bars: every past bug has a test

aspects.name: DOCUMENTATION
moves: Check the README explains {s} in one paragraph.
Document why {s} exists, not just what it does.
Give {s} a worked example.
List the invariants {s} must keep.
Record known limits of {s} honestly.
Check the docs for {s} still match the code.

aspects.name: SECURITY & PRIVACY
moves: List what {s} stores, sends and receives.
Remove any data {s} does not need.
Check {s} under the site's response headers.
Keep {s} free of third-party requests it does not need.
Validate every external value {s} accepts.
Review {s} against a content-security policy.

aspects.name: CACHING & DELIVERY
moves: Record how {s} is cached by the browser and the service worker.
Version {s} so a new build replaces it.
Make {s} revalidate without blocking render.
Check {s} after two deploys in a row.
Precompress {s} where the host allows.
Keep {s} cacheable for as long as it is immutable.

aspects.name: CONSISTENCY
moves: Compare {s} with its nearest sibling and list differences.
Replace one-off values on {s} with shared tokens.
Make {s} behave like every other control of its kind.
Match {s} corner radii, borders and weights to the system.
Remove duplicate CSS rules that style {s}.
Count !important rules affecting {s} and cut them.

aspects.name: RESILIENCE
moves: Kill {s} mid-operation and record the state it leaves.
Make {s} restart cleanly after a crash.
Bound every queue and buffer in {s}.
Keep {s} within memory on an old phone.
Survive a storage-quota error in {s}.
Run {s} for 24 hours and check for drift or leaks.

aspects.name: CRAFT DETAIL
moves: Inspect {s} at 400% zoom and list every imperfection.
Fix the smallest visible flaw on {s}.
Check {s} antialiasing on light and dark backgrounds.
Align {s} to whole pixels at every DPR.
Balance the optical weight of {s} with its neighbours.
Compare {s} with the best reference you know and close one gap.

depths.name: OBSERVE
depths.text: Record every instance first; change nothing yet.

depths.name: SYSTEMATISE
depths.text: Turn the fix into a shared token, rule or component used everywhere it applies.

depths.name: PROVE
depths.text: Add an automated QA check that fails if it regresses.

depths.name: SUSTAIN
depths.text: Wire the check into the generators so no build can ship without it.
